# Task record template

Copy metadata shape from an existing [task](../progress/tasks/LED-001.md); use a new unique ID. Set exact repository-relative coverage prefixes/globs for changed components, actual dependencies/read set and required evidence categories.

## Scope and acceptance

Audit IDs, owner role, concrete behavior and acceptance scenarios.

## Implemented

What changed in this change, or explicitly none.

## Remaining and unverified

Incomplete behavior, limitations, unresolved checks and why.

## Verification results

Exact checks/outcomes and linked evidence; failures and unrun checks included.

## Deployment

Environment/migration/artifact status; explicitly not deployed if applicable.

## Handoff

Next action, blockers, claimed files and integration instructions.

## History

Append dated actor/platform entries for every claim, scope change, failure, handoff and completion.
